race.comment: CHILLI REAPER (7) sets the standard after resuming with a sharp Mt Gambier win, coming from well back to beat Imacreedytwo by a head at generous odds. She is two wins from three starts around 1000m and the same jockey stays aboard, making her the one to beat. SUPER CHOICE (2) has been close in Class 1 and Class 2 company this campaign, with interference at Gawler last time giving him a genuine excuse. Worth consideration. OLD TIME ROCK (4) wide run last start is a fair excuse, and the prior soft-track win keeps him in the mix for the minors. ECLAIR VITALITY (3) last-start BM62 winner from Jamestown and proven around 1000m. Can threaten.
